name: Retrieval / RAG Poisoning
description: Malicious content placed in a knowledge source an application retrieves from — a vector store, indexed documents, a shared workspace or mailbox — so that it is pulled into prompts and acts as an indirect injection or biases answers.
differs: Canonical form of registry entry IOPC-R006. Scoped to retrieval-time corruption of a knowledge source the organisation owns. Persistent Memory Poisoning (T2.002) targets an agent's own durable state; public content aimed at AI search and assistants is AI Recommendation Poisoning (T2.006).
